nodes.label: toolContent()
nodes.rationale: Serializes MCP tool results through the compression seam; if the compressor returns a ref (remote retrieval), falls back to raw text so external callers never receive an unretrievable reference — a compensating-write guard

nodes.label: POST() MCP handler
nodes.rationale: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP endpoint; tool execution gated fail-closed on mcp_enabled flag (default false) — protocol discovery stays open, but no data is served until flag is explicitly enabled; anonymous callers receive a public-read-only principal

nodes.label: GET() REST discover
nodes.rationale: Public REST mirror of MCP personus_search for ChatGPT GPT Actions / OpenAPI consumers; shares the same mcp_enabled flag gate, anonymous principal, and searchPersonas call as the MCP endpoint — intentionally symmetric

nodes.label: POST() platform webhook
nodes.rationale: Inbound message gateway for Slack/Discord/Telegram bots; verifies HMAC/Ed25519 signatures, normalizes payload, delegates to Mastra Discovery agent; feature-flag gated fail-closed so a disabled endpoint reveals no platform slug reconnaissance

nodes.label: POST() CopilotKit
nodes.rationale: AG-UI bridge exposing Mastra agents to the CopilotKit agentic UI; scopes agent memory to userId as resourceId; anonymous callers blocked in production (fail-closed) but allowed locally for dev ergonomics

nodes.label: requireAdmin()
nodes.rationale: Fail-closed admin gate for server actions: if CASL check fails or auth/DB is unavailable, redirects home rather than leaking the admin surface — errors are caught and logged, not surfaced

nodes.label: getAdminPrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Nullifying admin check for page components: checks CASL ability.can('manage','AdminSurface'), catches auth/DB errors, returns null (fail-closed) so pages render a deny state instead of throwing — same gate as requireAdmin but returns null rather than redirecting

nodes.label: toggleFlagAction()
nodes.rationale: Admin server action that enforces CASL admin gate before writing a feature-flag toggle; uses stored valueType for coercion — raw client string is never trusted for type

nodes.label: updateSettingAction()
nodes.rationale: Identical security posture to toggleFlagAction: CASL gate first, stored valueType coercion, revalidates both /settings and /flags paths since settings changes can affect flag rendering

nodes.label: register()
nodes.rationale: Fail-fast env validation at Node.js process boot (not edge, not build time); prevents cryptic first-request errors by calling validateEnv() immediately — guarded to nodejs runtime only

nodes.label: GET()
nodes.rationale: REST persona lookup gated behind mcp_enabled feature flag; falls back to anonymous MCP principal for public visibility; toPublicPersona strips private fields before response

nodes.label: POST()
nodes.rationale: GDPR user lifecycle handler; verifyWebhook exceptions are caught and treated as unverified (fail-closed on trust, never 500); only user.deleted triggers a soft-delete — all other event types are silently acknowledged

nodes.label: CoachPage()
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent UI surface routing CopilotKit to three Mastra agents (persona-coach, discovery, recommender) by re-mounting CopilotKit per agent key change to reset runtime context

nodes.label: createCommunityAction()
nodes.rationale: requirePrincipal gate before delegating to service; founding persona URI is caller-supplied and validated by the service layer

nodes.label: searchAction()
nodes.rationale: Hybrid search: embedText for vector ranking, automatic text-only retry when semantic results are empty or embedText returns null (no API key). Falls back to anonymous MCP principal so unauthenticated users can explore public personas.

nodes.label: respondAction()
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates three-step approval fan-out: (1) respondToContact writes decision, (2) ContactRelay.deliver sends privacy-mediated introduction using recipient's preferred relay mode resolved from personas.contactPreferences, (3) NotificationTransport.send fires in-app notice. Delivery failures are non-fatal (warn log only).

nodes.label: createPersonaAction()
nodes.rationale: Two-phase pattern: (1) createPersona is authoritative and must succeed, (2) embedPersona + updatePersonaEmbedding is best-effort in a try/catch — persona creation never blocks on embedding failure

nodes.label: PersonaPage()
nodes.rationale: SSR mirror of the REST persona endpoint; same visibility-gate logic (getOptionalPrincipal ?? getAnonymousMcpPrincipal) and same getPersonaByUri call but renders traits/skills directly in HTML rather than JSON

nodes.label: LedgerRow()
nodes.rationale: Signature UI element: renders a persona as an entry in the capability register (ledger), exposing uri, displayName, capability, and endorsement count — the public face of the Persona concept.

nodes.label: LedgerEntry
nodes.rationale: Data contract for the register view: fields (uri, displayName, capability, endorsements) directly mirror the personas table projection consumed by the landing/explore surface.

nodes.label: SignedOut()
nodes.rationale: Shared UI-layer auth gate: the fail-open complement to requirePrincipal — rendered when getPagePrincipal() returns null, providing a consistent unauthenticated empty state without a hard redirect.

nodes.label: SiteNav()
nodes.rationale: Global navigation host: surfaces all five product areas (Explore, Communities, Coach, Inbox, You) and provisions ThemeToggle into the sticky header — primary product-area wayfinding.

nodes.label: ThemeToggle()
nodes.rationale: Hydration-safe theme switcher: defers label and icon until mounted to prevent server/client markup mismatch; delegates all interaction and visual rendering to Button.

nodes.label: ThemeProvider()
nodes.rationale: Root-level theme context adapter: thin wrapper over next-themes NextThemesProvider, isolating the dependency seam.

nodes.label: Button()
nodes.rationale: Primary design-system interaction primitive: CVA-driven variant/size system with asChild polymorphism via Radix Slot; consumed by ThemeToggle and all action surfaces.

nodes.label: Card()
nodes.rationale: Design-system layout container: rounded border card with sub-components (CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent) using cn() for class composition.

nodes.label: Input()
nodes.rationale: Design-system form input: consistent focus-visible, disabled, and placeholder styles; used in Explore search and Coach forms.

nodes.label: TabsTrigger()
nodes.rationale: Design-system tab trigger wrapping Radix TabsPrimitive: active-state underline pattern mirrors SiteNav active link styling — shared visual language for selected-surface indicators.

nodes.label: personus.spec.ts
nodes.rationale: End-to-end coverage anchor: exercises auth gates (SignedOut on /me), ledger register render, theme toggle hydration, nav routing to Explore/Coach, MCP JSON-RPC initialization, and offline explore degradation.

nodes.label: requirePrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Server-action auth gate: resolves principal and redirects to /sign-in when unauthenticated, preventing UnauthorizedError from surfacing as a 500 — fail-hard pattern for mutations.

nodes.label: getPagePrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Page-level fail-open auth resolver: catches auth/DB errors and returns null so RSC pages can render SignedOut or an offline state rather than crashing — centralizes the try/catch that every gated page used to repeat.

nodes.label: cn()
nodes.rationale: Tailwind class-merge utility: combines clsx conditional logic with tailwind-merge conflict resolution; the shared composition primitive for every design-system component.

nodes.label: nextConfig
nodes.rationale: Build-time monorepo integration config: transpilePackages lists all workspace packages (JIT TypeScript), serverExternalPackages excludes Mastra and Neon driver from edge/client bundles — enforces server-only boundary for AI and DB.

nodes.label: runAuditedTool()
nodes.rationale: Central gate pattern for every agent tool: extracts delegated Principal from Mastra RequestContext, runs tool body, emits one audit row; catches ForbiddenError (CASL denial) and maps it to 'forbidden' reason — the tool-layer equivalent of the service-layer CASL gate

nodes.label: redactPIIDeep()
nodes.rationale: Defense-in-depth PII guard on the persona write path; enforces contact-data exclusion from persisted persona fields regardless of whether the model called check_pii first

nodes.label: handlePlatformMessage()
nodes.rationale: Single entry point for all platform-bot inbound messages; fail-soft: missing community binding or absent API key yields a friendly reply rather than a throw; threads platform Principal via contextWithPrincipal before handing off to discoveryAgent

nodes.label: main() [backfill-embeddings]
nodes.rationale: Idempotent embedding backfill orchestrator; uses embeddingsWorker system actor (not a user principal) to write vectors for personas where embedding IS NULL; resumes safely on partial runs

nodes.label: getToolPrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Fail-closed identity extraction from Mastra RequestContext; dev-fallback is explicitly blocked in production so a missing principal always throws, preventing silent unauthorized tool execution

nodes.label: sanitize()
nodes.rationale: Recursively collapses all string leaves to presence booleans before writing to audit_log — prevents LLM-populated text (including embedded PII) from appearing in audit records

nodes.label: personaEmbeddingText()
nodes.rationale: Composes the text fed to the embedding model from the same trait dimensions the completeness scorer uses (headline, skills, qualities, values, offerings, seekingOpportunities), coupling the two analytic views to the same canonical field set

nodes.label: getOptionalPrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Central AuthN→DB→AuthZ orchestrator: resolves session via serverAuth, provisions DB user via resolveDbUser, then builds CASL ability via buildAbilityContext+defineAbilitiesFor. Every service-layer call is gated on the Principal this function returns. Fail-open to null (not throw) for unauthenticated callers.

nodes.label: getPrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Fail-closed gate wrapper: delegates to getOptionalPrincipal, throws UnauthorizedError on null. Enforces mandatory authentication for protected surfaces.

nodes.label: asAgent()
nodes.rationale: Agent delegation pattern: narrows a user Principal to an agent-scoped Principal inheriting the user's ability but carrying delegatedAuthority with agentId, sessionId, and optional constraints. Requires a 'user' actorType base — cannot be chained from another agent or system actor.

nodes.label: getAnonymousMcpPrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Fail-closed MCP gate: unauthenticated MCP callers receive only public-read-only ability (read Persona+Community), networkDepth=1. Client fingerprint is hashed for audit traceability without storing PII.

nodes.label: getPlatformPrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Same trust level as anonymous MCP: public-read-only ability, networkDepth=1. actorType is 'platform-bot' (NOT 'agent') because there is no user-delegation chain — the bot is an independent external actor. Sender ref hashed for audit without PII storage.

nodes.label: getDevPrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Local-only credential-free boot path: returns narrow read-only Principal for the CopilotKit streaming route when no AuthN is configured. Hard production guard (returns null in production). Mirrors anonymous trust level without a real session.

nodes.label: getSystemPrincipal()
nodes.rationale: Constructs a Principal for named system actors with no session. Enforces production guard on actors marked _productionGuard — prevents destructive actors from being constructed in production.

nodes.label: embeddingsWorker
nodes.rationale: Minimal-authority embeddings actor: read persona content, write ONLY the vector index via the 'index' action (distinct from 'update'). The separate 'index' action prevents an ordinary editing principal from poisoning vector embeddings.

nodes.label: retentionCron
nodes.rationale: Production-guarded destructive actor: purge ActivityEvent only; _productionGuard prevents construction in production. Dev/test only — guards against data retention violations in non-production environments.

nodes.label: seedActor
nodes.rationale: Reference-data provisioning actor: manage TraitMetadata+TraitTaxonomy+CommunityType. The only actor permitted to write trait metadata rows that drive the consumer UI trait taxonomy.

nodes.label: webhookAuth
nodes.rationale: Inbound AuthN webhook actor for user provisioning: create+update User only. Anchors external IdP subject IDs to internal DB user rows, enabling the Principal's resolveDbUser path.

nodes.label: defineAbilitiesFor()
nodes.rationale: Main CASL ability builder: default-deny, owner grants. Admin role gets manage/purge on all subjects. Community-admin role checked dynamically via communityRoles map. The 'purge' action is the hard-delete escape hatch never granted to ordinary users.

nodes.label: buildNarrowAbility()
nodes.rationale: Narrow explicit-grant ability builder for system/bot actors: only the enumerated (action, subject) pairs are permitted. Used by anonymous MCP, platform-bot, dev, embeddings worker, and retention cron actors — none of which should have the full user ability set.

nodes.label: buildAbilityContext()
nodes.rationale: DB-backed CASL context gatherer: queries personas table for the user's persona URIs and communityMembers for their community roles. These two DB reads establish the ownership and community-admin scoping used by defineAbilitiesFor.

nodes.label: defineAbilitiesForRole()
nodes.rationale: Role-only CASL shortcut for proxy/middleware admin gating: no DB lookup, no ownership scope. Used at surfaces (middleware, proxy) where DB context is not yet available. Delegates to defineAbilitiesFor with empty context.

nodes.label: compression
nodes.rationale: Fail-open token compression facade: compress() never throws — any proxy error returns input unchanged. Sits in front of the LLM in Mastra agent turns. isActive() lets callers skip the overhead when noop is selected.

nodes.label: selectProvider()
nodes.rationale: Vendor-neutral provider factory: env-var driven (COMPRESSION_PROVIDER), falls back to noop with a logged warning on unknown name or missing HEADROOM_PROXY_URL. Mirrors the same seam pattern as auth/index.ts:select().

nodes.label: HeadroomProvider
nodes.rationale: OFF BY DEFAULT — gated on vetting spike (latency + security of compressor in request path). compress() fails open: any HTTP error or timeout returns original text unchanged. retrieve() throws on failure (no fallback — ref-based retrieval is a hard dependency).

nodes.label: NoopProvider
nodes.rationale: Zero-behavior-change passthrough: default provider until a real compressor is explicitly configured. retrieve() always throws because noop never mints refs. Safe to call unconditionally — no latency, no external dependency.

nodes.label: getContactRelay()
nodes.rationale: Mediated contact gate: resolves a ContactRelay by recipient preferred mode without ever exposing raw contact details to the requester. contact_requests stores no email/phone — all delivery happens through this relay. Default is in_app; email_relay and signal are stubs.

nodes.label: InAppRelay
nodes.rationale: Default ContactRelay implementation: records mediated introduction in-app (recipient inbox). Never exposes requester's contact info. Only wired delivery mode; email_relay and signal are stubs.

nodes.label: EmailRelay
nodes.rationale: Stub ContactRelay for pseudonymous email relay. NOT_WIRED — throws on use. Planned to route replies through a masked address so recipient can reply without exposing their real email.

nodes.label: select()
nodes.rationale: AuthN provider factory: env-var driven (AUTH_PROVIDER), defaults to clerk, logs warning and falls back to clerk on unknown provider. Module-level singleton — provider is selected once at module load. Mirrors same seam pattern as compression/index.ts:selectProvider().

nodes.label: index.ts (db singleton)
nodes.rationale: Lazy Proxy avoids build-time crash when DATABASE_URL absent; setDbForTests injection gate lets integration tests swap in a pg17+pgvector handle without touching service code.

nodes.label: setDbForTests()
nodes.rationale: Test injection gate — swaps production db with a test handle; null resets to lazy path. Enables service-layer integration tests without mocking the ORM.

nodes.label: orm.ts (canonical drizzle re-export)
nodes.rationale: Single re-export of drizzle-orm so all workspace packages share one type instance; prevents SQL/Column type mismatches from duplicate peer resolutions across the monorepo.

nodes.label: baseFields()
nodes.rationale: Canonical base for externally-referenced entities: bigserial id + nanoid17 public_id + full audit cols + deletedAt soft-delete. Hard-delete (purge) is a CASL escape hatch, not the default.

nodes.label: referenceFields()
nodes.rationale: Reference/lookup table base: same audit cols + soft-delete as baseFields but no public_id — these tables are keyed by slug, not an external ID.

nodes.label: junctionFields()
nodes.rationale: Pure M2M junction base: no public_id (not externally addressable), no deletedAt — membership ends by row deletion, not soft-hide.

nodes.label: auditLogFields()
nodes.rationale: Append-only event stream base: uuid PK + created_by + created_at only. No updated_* or deleted_at — rows are immutable once written.

nodes.label: formatPrincipal
nodes.rationale: Namespace-typed principal strings (clerk:, system:, agent:, webhook:, migration:) stored in created_by/updated_by columns; CASL uses these prefixes to distinguish principal types for authz decisions.

nodes.label: publicId()
nodes.rationale: Prefixed nanoid17 (URL-safe, ~102 bits entropy) decouples external API contracts from internal bigserial PKs; prefix encodes entity type for readability.

nodes.label: personas (table)
nodes.rationale: Core entity: a published view of a user's trait pool. Carries traits JSONB, 1536-dim pgvector embedding for semantic search, and mcpEnabled/mcpTraitVisibility for MCP exposure controls.

nodes.label: communities (table)
nodes.rationale: Universal group container with its own 1536-dim embedding for community-to-user matching. backingPersonaUri links a guild/org's persona representation back to its community.

nodes.label: communityMembers (junction)
nodes.rationale: Triangular junction: userId + personaId + communityId. Membership is tied to a specific persona lens, not just the bare user — enforces that users participate through personas.

nodes.label: coachSessions (table)
nodes.rationale: Tracks Mastra agent coaching interactions; kind discriminates persona_coach vs recommender flows. traitsUpdated JSONB records agent-mutated traits; completeness delta measures coaching impact.

nodes.label: contactRequests (table)
nodes.rationale: Mediated contact schema — never stores raw contact details; delivery delegated to @personus/contact (ContactRelay). trustChain + triageScore enable AI triage of inbound requests.

nodes.label: endorsements (table)
nodes.rationale: Directional attestations that survive community deletion (SET NULL on communityId). CHECK constraint enforces toPersonaUri OR toShadowPersonaId is non-null — endorsement must target something.

nodes.label: activityEvents (table)
nodes.rationale: User-facing timeline (append-only, uuid PK). Distinct from audit_log (security events). personaUri scopes events to a persona lens rather than bare userId.

nodes.label: auditLog (table)
nodes.rationale: Security event log (append-only, no update/delete). kind+reasonCode are structured; metadata JSONB carries context. Retention is a separate concern from activityEvents.

nodes.label: guildRequests (table)
nodes.rationale: Inbound needs routed to guild members; matchedCategoryIds + matchedOfferingId track AI-assisted skill matching. selectedPersonaUri records which member accepted the request.

nodes.label: guildOfferings (table)
nodes.rationale: Services/products a guild exposes. priceModel JSONB is commerce-ready without a fixed schema. skillCategoryIds array links to guildSkillCategories for AI-driven discovery routing.

nodes.label: platformChannelBindings (table)
nodes.rationale: Lean binding record: only persists community-to-platform mapping + opaque adapterConfig. Mastra's channels primitive owns webhook routing, threading, dedup, and per-thread memory — no hand-rolled plumbing.

nodes.label: queryLogs (table)
nodes.rationale: Discovery query analytics: tracks natural-language queries, match counts, and whether a query led to contact. agentId is opaque UUID (not FK) — agent identity is not persisted as a relation.

nodes.label: communityTypes (table)
nodes.rationale: Reference data driving community creation: communityTraitSchema + memberTraitSchema define which traits are collected per community type, mirroring the trait_metadata pattern. featureFlags JSONB gates type-specific behavior.

nodes.label: shadowPersonas
nodes.rationale: Placeholder for non-users claimable via token. Stores vector(1536) embedding with ivfflat cosine index — parallel structure to personas but with claimStatus/claimToken lifecycle. Also tracks which persona created it and which claimed it.

nodes.label: userTraits
nodes.rationale: Master JSONB trait pool per user, GIN-indexed for search. updatePersonaTraits mirrors all trait writes here as a best-effort compensating write so traits are accessible at user scope beyond any single persona.

nodes.label: traitTaxonomies
nodes.rationale: Suggested values per (traitKey, taxonomySlug). Persona Coach's lookup_suggestions tool surfaces these — metadata-driven discovery path for trait autocomplete.

nodes.label: canViewPersona()
nodes.rationale: Pure visibility gate encoding domain invariants: owner bypass, then public/authenticated/community/private tiers. No I/O — services do DB reads and call this to make the decision.

nodes.label: canViewEndorsement()
nodes.rationale: Pure gate for endorsement visibility. Caller resolves community membership separately then passes isCommunityMember flag — decouples DB lookup from decision logic.

nodes.label: canRespondToContact()
nodes.rationale: Only recipient (owner of target persona) may respond, and only while status=pending. respondToContact surfaces NotFoundError (not ForbiddenError) on failure to avoid leaking existence.

nodes.label: toPublicPersona()
nodes.rationale: Canonical external projection stripping internal columns (userId, embedding, deletedAt, contactPreferences, mcp flags). Single shared function so MCP and REST/GPT-Actions surfaces project identically.

nodes.label: relayModeFor()
nodes.rationale: Resolves ContactRelayMode from recipient persona's contactPreferences JSONB. Centralizes delivery-mode logic so ContactRelay/NotificationTransport concerns stay out of the service layer.

nodes.label: services/index
nodes.rationale: Service layer entry point. Uses structural ServicePrincipal (userId + CASL ability) rather than importing auth.Principal to avoid auth→db→auth cycle. All service functions enforce BOTH CASL can() AND ownership. Re-exports all sub-service modules.

nodes.label: updatePersona()
nodes.rationale: Enforces CASL can('update','Persona') + ownership before patching base fields. Returns null for missing persona (not error) so Persona Coach can distinguish not-found from forbidden.

nodes.label: updatePersonaTraits()
nodes.rationale: Writes traits to persona then mirrors to user_traits master pool as a compensating write (Neon HTTP has no interactive transactions). Callers merge-by-key before calling.

nodes.label: createCommunity()
nodes.rationale: Founder joins as admin member on creation. Compensating delete guards against orphan community (memberCount:1, no member row) when the member insert fails — Neon HTTP, no interactive transactions.

nodes.label: joinCommunity()
nodes.rationale: Fail-closed gate: only open communities allow self-service join. Approval/invite_only policies throw ForbiddenError rather than silently bypassing the unbuilt flow.

nodes.label: respondToContact()
nodes.rationale: Non-owner probing a request id receives NotFoundError (not ForbiddenError) to prevent existence leakage. Delivery (ContactRelay/NotificationTransport) is left to the caller after a successful response.

nodes.label: seedTraitMetadata()
nodes.rationale: Seeds 12 core trait keys with category, dataType, displayConfig, editConfig. Skip-if-exists idempotency bootstraps metadata-driven UI rendering for the Persona Coach collection flow.

nodes.label: seedSystemSettings()
nodes.rationale: Insert-on-first-run; on re-run refreshes metadata only, preserving admin-overridden values. Seeds 6 feature flags (features.*) read by @personus/flags DbProvider and AI model keys (ai.*) consumed by Mastra agents.

nodes.label: main() seed orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Ordered seed sequence: system_settings first (feature flags and AI config needed at runtime), then community_types, trait_metadata, taxonomies. All steps idempotent.

nodes.label: createContactRequest()
nodes.rationale: Double gate: requires authenticated principal (userId present) AND CASL 'create ContactRequest'; validates claimed from-persona ownership before inserting. Stores NO raw contact details — ContactRelay owns delivery.

nodes.label: createEndorsement()
nodes.rationale: Enforces XOR target constraint (real persona OR shadow persona, never both) via endorsementTargetValid gate before insert — mirrors DB check constraint at the service layer.

nodes.label: listCommunities()
nodes.rationale: Authenticated principal sees their joined communities (inner join on communityMembers); anonymous sees public-only up to MAX_COMMUNITY_LIST cap.

nodes.label: deletePersona()
nodes.rationale: Soft-delete with compensating write: on persona deletion, auto-declines all pending contact requests addressed to that URI so they are never wedged without an owner to respond.

nodes.label: searchPersonas()
nodes.rationale: Dual-path: vector (pgvector cosine over embedding ivfflat index) when queryEmbedding supplied; ILIKE text fallback otherwise. mcpEnabled is an orthogonal agent-exposure opt-in, independent of human visibility.

nodes.label: updatePersonaEmbedding()
nodes.rationale: Strict write gate: only the embedding worker (CASL 'index Persona') or the persona's own owner may write vectors. Explicitly NOT granted to principals holding only 'update Persona', preventing a delegated editing agent from poisoning others' vectors.

nodes.label: getPersonaByUri()
nodes.rationale: Gated on both canViewPersona (human visibility) AND requireMcpEnabled flag for bot/MCP/REST surfaces — two independent exposure controls.

nodes.label: updateSystemSetting()
nodes.rationale: Coerces value type from the DB record's own stored valueType, not from client-supplied type — prevents a tampered form from writing a mismatched JSONB shape. Calls invalidateSetting after write (compensating cache eviction).

nodes.label: getSetting()
nodes.rationale: Fail-CLOSED: on DB error returns caller's fallback so the app stays operational during outage. Per-key TTL in-process cache; TTL overridable via SETTINGS_CACHE_TTL_MS.

nodes.label: bindPlatformChannel()
nodes.rationale: Idempotent: detects existing (platform, externalRef) binding and re-activates rather than violating the unique key. Prevents channel-stealing: only a revoked binding is free to re-claim; an active binding owned by a different community throws ForbiddenError.

nodes.label: assertCommunityAdmin()
nodes.rationale: Second gate behind CASL 'manage PlatformChannel': enforces community-admin membership. Both gates must pass for mutations — CASL provides role-based capability, this provides resource-scoped membership check.

nodes.label: resolveBoundCommunity()
nodes.rationale: No principal required — called from inbound webhook handlers where the caller is the platform bot, not a user. Looks up active binding by (platform, externalRef) for message routing.

nodes.label: DbProvider
nodes.rationale: Bridges OpenFeature standard to settings-cache fail-closed read path. Flag keys namespaced under 'features.' prefix. Inherits fail-closed behavior from getSetting.

nodes.label: selectProvider()
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates provider selection: DB default; PostHog/LaunchDarkly stubs throw; unknown name falls back to DB with a warning — always stays operational.

nodes.label: validateEnv()
nodes.rationale: Fail-fast in production, warn-and-continue in dev/test. Enforces webhook-secret co-presence with bot tokens (Slack needs signing secret, Discord needs public key, Telegram needs webhook secret) — misconfigured channels can't silently run without inbound verification.

nodes.label: setupTestDb()
nodes.rationale: pgvector-aware: tries CREATE EXTENSION vector; on failure replaces vector(n) columns with text and skips ivfflat indexes so service tests still run on plain Postgres without embeddings.

nodes.label: withTimeout()
nodes.rationale: Bounds caller's wait; does NOT cancel upstream work. Durations separately tunable per call type (TIMEOUT_LLM_MS, TIMEOUT_EMBED_MS, TIMEOUT_DB_MS).

nodes.label: listTraitMetadata()
nodes.rationale: No per-row gating — trait metadata describes the system catalog, not people. Public read path drives consumer UI trait picker.
